ruling.transport_disposition: One explicitly authorized B3 session (session 4 of 8, pair 4) as a bounded exception to the standing CH340 single-byte-deletion transport stop-loss; no general release.

transport_stop_loss_decision.decision: One explicitly authorized B3 session (session 4 of 8, pair 4) as a bounded exception to the standing CH340 single-byte-deletion transport stop-loss; no general release.
transport_stop_loss_decision.basis: The owner elects this single session for lifecycle 2 at S3 (manifest 258bb14c…) after the S3 proof node (a8275e8, accepted under the named exceptions for engineering purposes; the formal clean-tree proof not passed) and the main-experiment preparation (1a9ada9). Byte deletions on the UART transport remain observed and their cause unresolved; the 0.38/MB figure of 2026-10-14 is a pooled observation over mixed conditions, not a rate and not a success probability.
transport_stop_loss_decision.preserved: No acceptance-contract change, no larger loss budget, no exclusion of recovered CRC events from the existing ledger, no erasure of prior HOLD / LOST attempts; the heartbeat rule v07 unchanged.
transport_stop_loss_decision.cross_session_counting: B3Q -01 (35d81c2) counts once as 'a contiguous inbound deletion causing a session HOLD'; session 0 attempt 1 (7677d23) counts once as a claimed attempt without COMPLETED of its own cause (carrier configuration timeout); session 0 attempt 2 and sessions 1, 2 and 3 PASSED and reset neither; session 3's heartbeat-burst damage (one record, within rule v07's budget) was ruled the same class recurring and absorbed, not a counted loss. The same loss again triggers the two-sessions-same-cause stop-loss; a different frame type or finding text is not a new cause. COMPLETED means the epoch's end state; three claimed attempts without COMPLETED trigger the design review.
transport_stop_loss_decision.after_attempt: The exception is spent after this session, whatever its outcome. A KILL stops the line. Any HOLD, LOST, PROTOCOL or other non-PASS outcome is archived as observed; the archived verdict stands; only a CONFIRMED transport or instrument loss may be re-run, separately authorised, for the same pair and seeds under a new ruling pair. A recurrence of session 0 attempt 1's configuration timeout triggers the two-attempts-same-cause stop-loss: no further attempt before a diagnosis. PASS does not itself lift the transport stop-loss and authorises no later session.

Stop immediately on a preflight refusal or any session stop condition (KEY_NOT_LOADED, PAGE_MISMATCH, a U-Boot banner, the deadline, a refused candidate, an unacknowledged record or identity, STOP_PAGE / STOP_LINK3 / PROTOCOL_*, a DevC DMA timeout or error bit, the CRC or bad-frame budget exceeded). Preserve partial and complete evidence, both ruling archives and the actual boundary record. No automatic restart, second session, new seed, new budget or renewed ruling is authorised by this pair.

After the session: archive in form (c) (evidence/b3/main_preparation_2026_10_14/archive_session.py → evidence/b3/b3_17A6_2026-10-15-04, external backup), run the fresh restore and re-judge (restore_rejudge.py must ACCEPT), commit the session as one commit, and report for review. The next session's ruling pair is signed only after that review. No pooled primary, no transition and no result document is authorised by this pair.
The pooled primary will take each of the eight pairs' FIRST qualifying PASS; no HOLD pair is dropped to shrink N; every attempt stays archived and disclosed in the result document.

The B3Q sessions' measured rates entered this session only through the pinned calibration (3180.049965139327 x 0.85 = rate_for_split); B2's sessions are not inputs.

Session 4 runs only after sessions 0–3 were re-judged and reviewed (626f228). The evidence goes to a NEW directory (build raw → evidence/b3/b3_17A6_2026-10-15-04).
